title: CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

paragraphs.en: Anne and Matthew were left alone in the cheerful kitchen of Green Gables on a frosty January night. A bright fire crackled in the old-fashioned stove, and frost crystals sparkled on the windows. Matthew read the Farmers' Advocate while Anne studied her geometry with determination, though she kept glancing at a new book Jane Andrews had lent her.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个寒风刺骨的一月夜晚，安妮和马修独自留在绿山墙农舍温暖的厨房里。炉火在古色古香的铸铁炉中噼啪作响，窗户上结着晶莹的冰花。马修一边读着《农民倡导报》，一边若有所思；而安妮则专心致志地研究几何学，尽管她时不时地瞥向简·安德鲁斯借给她的那本新书。

paragraphs.en: "Matthew, did you ever study geometry when you went to school?" Anne asked.
paragraphs.zh: “马修，你上学的时候学过几何吗？”安妮问道。

paragraphs.en: "No, I didn't," Matthew replied, waking from his doze.
paragraphs.zh: “不，我没有。”马修醒过来回答道。

paragraphs.en: "I wish you had," Anne sighed. "Then you'd understand how difficult it is for me. You can't sympathize properly if you've never studied it.
paragraphs.zh: “我希望你也有过这样的经历，”安妮叹了口气，“那样你就能理解这对我来说有多艰难。如果你从未经历过，就很难真正感同身受。”

paragraphs.en: It's ruining my life."
paragraphs.zh: 这可真是把我的生活给毁了。

paragraphs.en: Anne turned away from the clock shelf where her book lay and tried to focus on her studies.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮扭头离开了放着书籍的钟架，试图集中精力学习。

paragraphs.en: Matthew comforted Anne soothingly. "I guess you're the smartest scholar and making rapid progress, as Mr. Phillips told me last week at Blair's store. He said so himself."
paragraphs.zh: 马修安慰着安妮：“我想你是最聪明的学生，进步也很快。菲利普斯先生上周在布莱尔商店告诉我时就是这样说的。”

paragraphs.en: "Geometry is confusing," Anne complained. "He uses different letters than in the book, which makes it hard to follow. I don't think a teacher should take such an advantage."
paragraphs.zh: “几何学真让人摸不着头脑，”安妮抱怨道，“他用的字母和书里的不一样，这让我很难跟上。我觉得老师不应该这样占优势。”

paragraphs.en: They discussed agriculture class. "I've learned what makes the roads red—it’s comforting," Anne said.
paragraphs.zh: 他们讨论了农业课。“我学会了为什么道路会变红——这让人感到安心，”安妮说道。

paragraphs.en: Matthew was Conservative, and so was Anne. She wondered about Marilla and Mrs. Lynde's experiences in Canada.
paragraphs.zh: 马修是保守派，安妮也是如此。她对玛丽拉和林德太太在加拿大的经历感到有些好奇。

paragraphs.en: "Do you ever go courting, Matthew?" she asked curiously.
paragraphs.zh: “马修，你偶尔也会去追求爱情吗？”她好奇地问道。

paragraphs.en: "No, I never thought of such a thing," Matthew replied honestly.
paragraphs.zh: “没有，我从没想过这种事。”马修诚实地说道。

paragraphs.en: Anne finds Matthew interesting but prefers a single, sensible beau over many. She mentions Ruby Gillis's plans to have numerous admirers, though Anne would rather have just one rational one.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮觉得马修挺有趣，但她更倾向于有一个理性而稳重的追求者，而不是众多仰慕者。她提到鲁比·吉尔思打算拥有很多追求者，但安妮宁愿只有一个理智的追求者。

paragraphs.en: Matthew acknowledges he doesn’t fully understand everything himself. Anne decides she must finish her lessons before reading the new book Jane lent her, despite its tempting allure. She promises to lock it in the jam closet and asks Matthew not to give her the key until after her studies are complete, even if she begs.
paragraphs.zh: 马修承认自己也不完全明白所有事情。安妮决定在阅读简借给她的新书之前，必须先完成自己的功课。尽管那本书极具诱惑力，她还是做出了承诺，要把书锁在果酱柜里，并请马修在她学业完成后才把钥匙给她，即便她苦苦哀求也不例外。

paragraphs.en: Just as Anne returns from the cellar with russets, Diana Barry bursts into the kitchen, pale and breathless, wrapped in a shawl. Startled by the sudden intrusion, Anne drops her candle and plate, which crash down the cellar ladder and are found embedded in melted grease the next day by Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮刚从地窖里提着一篮栗子出来，戴安娜·巴瑞就闯进了厨房，面色苍白，气喘吁吁，身上裹着一件围巾。玛丽拉被突然的闯入吓了一跳，手中的蜡烛和盘子掉落在地上，摔下了 cellar 梯子，第二天被玛丽拉在融化的油脂中找到。

paragraphs.en: Anne rushed over to Diana, who was visibly distressed. "Whatever is the matter, Diana?" she asked.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮急忙跑向显得明显不安的戴安娜，“怎么了，戴安娜？”她问道。

paragraphs.en: Diana pleaded anxiously, "Oh, Anne, please come quickly! Minnie May is terribly sick with croup. Young Mary Joe says so—my parents are away in town and there's no one else to fetch a doctor."
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜焦急地恳求，“安妮，求你快点来吧！米妮·梅得了严重的喘嗽病。小玛丽·乔这么说的——我父母在镇上，没人能去叫医生了。”

paragraphs.en: Without hesitation, Matthew grabbed his cap and coat and headed into the dark yard.
paragraphs.zh: 马修毫不犹豫地抓起帽子和外套，朝黑暗的院子走去。

paragraphs.en: Anne hurriedly put on her hood and jacket, saying, "Matthew has gone to harness the sorrel mare for Dr. Carmody. I know him well enough to read his thoughts without words."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮匆匆戴上了斗篷和夹克，说道：“马修去给卡莫迪医生套那匹栗色母马了。我了解他，不用他说出口我就知道他在想什么。”

paragraphs.en: Diana cried, "I don't think he'll find a doctor at Carmody. Dr. Blair went to town, and I suspect Dr. Spencer might too. Young Mary Joe is inexperienced with croup, and Mrs. Lynde isn't here.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜喊道：“我觉得卡姆多不会找到医生。布莱尔医生去镇上了，我怀疑斯宾塞医生也可能去了。年轻玛丽·乔对喉炎毫无经验，而林德太太也不在。”

paragraphs.en: Oh, Anne!"
paragraphs.zh: 哦，安妮！

paragraphs.en: "Stop crying, Di," Anne said cheerfully. "I know exactly how to treat croup. Remember that Mrs. Hammond had twins three times—croup was common among them.
paragraphs.zh: “戴安娜，别哭了。”安妮愉快地说，“我知道怎么治疗喉炎。你还记得汉蒙德太太生过三对双胞胎——喉炎在她们家挺常见的。”

paragraphs.en: We'll get the ipecac bottle now—you might not have it at home."
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在去找催吐药瓶——你家里可能没有。”

paragraphs.en: The two girls hurried out hand in hand, navigating through Lover's Lane and across the deep snow-covered field. Anne, though concerned for Minnie May, felt a romantic thrill at once again sharing this adventure with her old friend.
paragraphs.zh: 两个女孩手拉手匆匆走出，沿着情人小径穿行，跨过那片深雪覆盖的田野。虽然安妮担心米妮·梅，但她立刻感受到了与老朋友一同经历这次冒险的浪漫兴奋。

paragraphs.en: The night was clear and frosty, with big stars shining over silent fields. Snow powdered the branches of dark fir trees as the wind whistled through them. Anne found it delightful to glide through such mystery and beauty with her long estranged bosom friend.
paragraphs.zh: 夜空清澈而寒冷，满天大星照耀着寂静的田野。寒风呼啸中，雪粉覆盖在黑暗松树的枝头。安妮觉得与久违的老友一同在这神秘而美丽的夜晚滑行是一种难得的享受。

paragraphs.en: Anne rushed into action with skill and urgency.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮迅速行动起来，既熟练又急切。

paragraphs.en: "Minnie May has croup; she's quite ill, but not the worst case I've seen. We need plenty of hot water first," Anne declared. "Diana, there’s barely a cup in the kettle!
paragraphs.zh: “米妮·梅得了百日咳，病得不轻，不过还没到最严重的情况。”安妮宣布道，“戴安娜，壶里几乎连一杯热水都没有了！”

paragraphs.en: I’ve filled it up now. Mary Joe, add some wood to the stove."
paragraphs.zh: 我现在加满了。玛丽乔，给炉子里添些木头。”

paragraphs.en: Anne undressed Minnie and placed her in bed while Diana searched for soft flannel cloths. Anne administered ipecac multiple times throughout the night, despite Minnie's resistance.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮给米妮脱了衣服，把她安置在床上。戴安娜则去找柔软的法兰绒布。整晚，尽管米妮极力反抗，安妮还是多次给她服用了吐根粉。

paragraphs.en: Young Mary Joe kept a roaring fire going and heated extra water. By three o'clock, Matthew arrived with a doctor from Spencervale. Minnie May was much improved and sleeping soundly.
paragraphs.zh: 年轻的小玛丽·乔生火取暖，还烧了一壶热水。三点钟时，马修带着斯潘塞维尔来的医生回来了。米妮·梅的情况有了很大好转，已经睡得沉沉的了。

paragraphs.en: Anne admitted she nearly gave up hope, fearing Minnie might choke to death. But after three minutes, Minnie coughed up phlegm and began to recover. Anne's relief was immense; words could not fully convey it.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮几乎要放弃希望，担心米妮可能会窒息而死。但经过三分钟的努力后，米妮咳出了痰，开始逐渐恢复过来。安妮的如释重负之情无法用言语完全表达出来。

paragraphs.en: Anne returned home on that crisp, frosty morning, her eyes heavy from lack of sleep but still chattering animatedly to Matthew as they crossed the long white field and walked under the glittering maples.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在那个清冷的早晨回到了家，虽然眼睛因熬夜而有些沉重，但还是和马修兴致勃勃地交谈着，两人穿过那片长长的白色田地，走过闪耀着红光的枫树下。

paragraphs.en: "Isn't it a wonderful morning? The world looks like something God just imagined for His own pleasure. Those trees look so delicate; I could blow them away with a breath—pouf!
paragraphs.zh: “这不是一个美妙的早晨吗？世界仿佛是上帝专门为自己的乐趣而创造出来的。那些树看起来如此娇嫩，我轻轻一吹就能把它们吹走——蓬的一声！”

paragraphs.en: I'm glad we have white frosts in this world, aren't you? And I’m relieved Mrs. Hammond had those twins after all. If she hadn’t, I might not know what to do for Minnie May."
paragraphs.zh: 我很高兴这个世界还有白霜，不是吗？而且我很庆幸贺蒙德太太最终生下了那对双胞胎。要是没有的话，我可能不知道该怎么照顾米妮·梅了。

paragraphs.en: Matthew looked at Anne’s pale face and the dark shadows under her eyes. "You’ll manage fine," he said. "Just go to bed and get some rest.
paragraphs.zh: 马修看着安妮苍白的脸和眼下的暗影，说道：“你一定能应付过来的。”他安慰道，“赶紧去睡觉，好好休息一下吧。”

paragraphs.en: I'll handle everything here."
paragraphs.zh: “我来搞定这里的一切。”

paragraphs.en: Anne promptly went to bed, sleeping deeply until well into the afternoon. When she woke, Marilla was in the kitchen, knitting.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮迅速上床，睡得非常沉，直到下午才醒来。这时，玛丽拉正在厨房里织毛线。

paragraphs.en: "Did you see the Premier?" Anne asked eagerly. "What did he look like, Marilla?"
paragraphs.zh: “你见到首相亲了没？”安妮急切地问，“他长什么样，玛丽拉？”

paragraphs.en: Marilla told Anne that Mrs. Barry had come to see her earlier, though she hadn’t mentioned it right away because Anne might have gotten too excited about it. After Anne finished eating the blue plum preserve, Marilla shared that Mrs. Barry said Anne had saved Minnie May's life and apologized for a past incident involving currant wine. She hoped Anne would forgive her and reconcile with Diana.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉告诉安妮，巴里太太早些时候来看过她了，不过她没有马上说出来，怕安妮会太激动。等安妮吃完蓝李子果酱后，玛丽拉才说，巴里太太提到安妮救了米妮·梅的命，并为过去涉及黑加仑酒的一件事向她道歉。她希望安妮能原谅她，并与戴安娜和好如初。

paragraphs.en: Anne was thrilled at the news. "Marilla, can I go now—without washing my dishes? I'll do them later.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮听到这个消息兴奋不已。“玛丽拉，我现在可以去——不用洗盘子了吗？我稍后洗。”

paragraphs.en: I can't be tied down to something so mundane as dishwashing right now."
paragraphs.zh: 我现在可没心思拘泥于洗盘子这种琐事。

paragraphs.en: "Go on then," Marilla said indulgently. "But Anne Shirley, are you crazy? Come back and put something on.
paragraphs.zh: “那你继续吧，”玛丽拉宽容地说，“不过安妮·谢里登，你是不是疯了？快回来把衣服穿上。”

paragraphs.en: You’re going out without a cap or wrap. Look at her running through the orchard with her hair flying. She might catch a cold."
paragraphs.zh: 你出门竟然没戴帽子或围巾。看看她那样在果园里奔跑，头发飞扬的，很容易着凉的。

paragraphs.en: Anne returned home in the twilight, her spirits high. The evening star shimmered in the pale golden sky over the snowy landscape. Sleigh bells tinkled among the hills, but Anne's joy was greater.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在暮色中回到了家中，心情格外愉快。晚星在雪地上空淡金色的天空中闪烁。山间传来马车铃声，但安妮的喜悦更为强烈。

paragraphs.en: "Marilla, I am perfectly happy," she declared. "Mrs. Barry apologized and cried, promising to forget our past. I told her politely that I had no hard feelings."
paragraphs.zh: “玛丽拉，我简直开心极了，”她宣布道，“巴里太太道歉了，还哭着保证会忘记过去的事情。我礼貌地告诉她我没有丝毫怨言。”

paragraphs.en: Anne felt she had done Mrs. Barry a favor. She shared with Marilla how Diana showed her a new crochet stitch. They promised never to reveal it.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮觉得自己帮了巴里太太一个忙。她和玛丽拉分享了戴安娜教她一种新钩针编织技法的事。她们 promise 保证永远不把这件事泄露出去。

paragraphs.en: Their afternoon was delightful. Diana gave Anne a card with roses and poetry. Anne longed for the grown-up treatment, especially when Mrs. Barry used her best china and asked about Anne's tea.
paragraphs.zh: 她们度过了一个愉快的下午。戴安娜送给安妮一张装饰着玫瑰和诗句的卡片。安妮渴望得到成年人般的礼遇，尤其是当巴里太太用她最好的瓷器茶具，并询问起安妮的茶点时。

paragraphs.en: "Marilla, being treated as if I were grown up is wonderful," she said, though Marilla sighed briefly in response.
paragraphs.zh: “玛丽拉，像对待大人一样对待我真是太好了，”她说道，不过玛丽拉只是短暂地叹了口气回应。

paragraphs.en: Anne declared she would always speak to little girls as if they were equals when she grew up, never laughing at their use of big words. She knew from experience how it hurt one's feelings. After tea, Diana and Anne made taffy but found it wasn't very good.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮宣称，等她长大了，一定会像对待平等的同伴一样和小女孩说话，绝不会因为她们使用了一些大词而发笑。她从亲身经历中知道这样做会伤害别人的情感。吃过茶点后，戴安娜和安妮做了糖块，但发现味道并不怎么样。

paragraphs.en: Diana left Anne to stir the mixture while she buttered the plates; Anne forgot and let it burn. The cat then walked over a plate that had to be discarded. Making the taffy was still fun.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜先去抹黄油盘子，让安妮搅拌糖浆混合物；不料安妮不小心让混合物烧焦了。这时，猫走过来踩到了一个必须丢弃的盘子。尽管如此，制作果冻糖的过程仍然很有趣。

paragraphs.en: Upon returning home, Mrs. Barry invited Anne to visit often, and Diana waved goodbye from the window as Anne went down Lover's Lane. That night, Anne promised to pray and create a special prayer for the occasion.
paragraphs.zh: 回到家后，巴里太太邀请安妮经常来玩。戴安娜在窗前挥手告别，目送安妮下到情人谷小径。当晚，安妮许诺要祈祷，并为这个场合特别祈求一番。
